entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex, and you've reached VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Finally! Look, I ordered a helmet and it's completely wrong. I want to return it right now. This is ridiculous.
I'm very sorry to hear there's an issue with your order. I can definitely look into that for you. To start, what specifically is the issue with the helmet?

What do you mean 'what's the issue'? I just told you! The color is completely off from what your website showed. It's hideous. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched the thing. Just process the return. Now.

I understand your frustration completely, and I apologize that the color wasn't what you expected. Of course, the safety of a perfectly fitting helmet is our top priority, and that includes you being happy with it. Let me just pull up your order information.
Don't 'pull up' my information, just do your job! This is the last time I order from you guys. I'm a VIP member, and this is the service I get? I want to speak to your manager.

I understand you'd like to speak to a manager, but I can resolve this for you right now. I see you're one of our VIP members, and we truly value your business. I've just checked the policy, and since you received the item only seven days ago, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can process a full refund for you immediately. I'll email you a prepaid return label right now.
Well... okay. A full refund, you said?

Yes, a full refund back to your original payment method. And for the trouble this has caused, I'd also like to add a $50 credit to your VeloFit account for your next purchase. We want to make sure you get exactly what you're looking for.
Fine. A $50 credit and the return label. That's acceptable. Send the email now.
I've just sent it. You should see it in your inbox within the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Just make sure it gets processed correctly.
It will be. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
